description: Alternative layout, not a replacement for Supplementary Figure 7. A: pre-context C1 heatmap. B, top: the exact actual-context heatmap from Figure 9 D. C, top: post-context C1 heatmap. All three show the same 203 eligible visual SUA, without a responsiveness filter, in the original context-only Rastermap order on Figure 9 D's +/-44 Hz scale; values beyond the limits saturate. Each condition subtracts its own per-unit preceding-grey display baseline pooled over complete half-open 20-ms bins. SDFs use 5-ms bins, a causal 25-ms exponential kernel, and the window -0.75 to +0.75 seconds. Each block contributes 34 presentations, including zero-spike trials; context trials retain Figure 9's clean-predecessor rule. Dashed lines mark onset; black bars mark each condition's median presentation duration. The same 203 units from mouse 830794's January 27, 2026 session are displayed. B, bottom: pre-C1 (dashed grey) and post-C1 (solid purple) baseline-subtracted mean SDFs across the same 51 units. Same eligible visual units in both control curves; actual-context 90-degree Q1 raw p <0.05 and signed MI >0.1; finite p and MI; no Q2 restriction. Shading is sample SD (ddof=1) across these neurons divided by sqrt(neuron count), not trial or across-mouse uncertainty. This population differs from Figure 9's positive Q1 AND Q2 mean-trace population. C, bottom: unchanged regional pseudo-Q1, pseudo-Q2, and Both fractions from 13 sessions, sharing 6642 jointly testable eligible units across included regions; intervals are the Figure 9 10,000-resample 95% mouse-cluster bootstrap. 95% percentile mouse-cluster bootstrap; resample contributing mice with replacement within each region and recompute summed responsive / summed joint-testable counts; fixed session/group inclusion and shared resamples for Q1, Q2 and Both. Pseudo-Q1 tests post-C1 versus its preceding within-block stimulus, whose orientation/type varies, not an expected standard. Pseudo-Q2 compares post-C1 with pre-C1 after each trial's grey-baseline subtraction. Both screens require raw p <0.05 and absolute MI >0.1, either sign; Both is their intersection. Cohort eligibility, region inclusion, counts, and exclusions are unchanged. This exploratory repeat comparison does not isolate prediction error or drift.

display.limit_rule: Exact Figure 9 D context-only pooled absolute 99th-percentile ceiling.

selection_rule: Same eligible visual units in both control curves; actual-context 90-degree Q1 raw p <0.05 and signed MI >0.1; finite p and MI; no Q2 restriction.
sem_rule: Across-neuron sample SD (ddof=1) / sqrt(n), same cells in both curves.
